tools.name: axenomia_capabilities
tools.description: List the AxenomIA engineering lab: the 3D physics available through this connector (parameters with units, boundary-condition kinds, what each is verified against), the naval tools, what is only in the web lab, units and pricing. Call this first.

tools.name: axenomia_naval_stability
tools.description: Hydrostatics (displacement, KB, BM, GM, TPC, MCT, form coefficients), the righting-arm GZ curve and the IMO intact-stability criteria of a hull. Hull forms: barcaza (rectangular barge), wigley, carga (cargo ship with parallel body). Lengths in m, rho in t/m³. Or give example: barcaza | pesquero | ca

tools.name: axenomia_plate
tools.description: Deflection and von Mises stress of a rectangular thin plate a × b × thickness (mm) under a uniform pressure (kPa) and self-weight; each edge x0, x1, y0, y1 clamped, simply (supported) or free. Steel by default (E 200 000 MPa, ν 0.3, fy 250 MPa). Free.

tools.name: axenomia_tank
tools.description: Vertical cylindrical tank (mm): radius, wall height, liquid height, wall thickness; liquid density kg/m³ (water 1000); base clamped (welded to a rigid bottom) or pinned. Thin-shell elements: hoop stress, bending moment and stress at the base, maximum radial deflection and where, von Mises, utilisati

tools.name: axenomia_inspect_geometry
tools.description: Mesh a part (mm): box {size:[L,W,H]} from the origin, cylinder {radius, length} along +z from the origin, or mesh {verts, faces} (closed triangle surface). Returns the mesh and the face groups (id, flat or curved, normal, centroid, area) to choose where boundary conditions go. Free.

tools.name: axenomia_solve_study
tools.description: Solve a 3D study on a part (mm) with AxenomIA’s finite-element solvers: physics one of physics.heat, physics.solid-mechanics, physics.modal, fluids.laminar-flow, fluids.turbulent-flow, physics.electric-currents, chemistry.species-transport. params: material values in the units from axenomia_capabili

tools.name: axenomia_agent_passport
tools.description: Read the versioned AX-SCI-001 Agent Passport: scope, evidence rules, evaluation status, limitations and human-review requirements.

tools.name: axenomia_human_review_gate
tools.description: Return the mandatory human-review boundary for AX-SCI-001. This tool never approves patentability, novelty, publication or research-priority decisions.

tools.name: ax_sci_001_assess_evidence
tools.description: Research and synthesize traceable scientific evidence for a research question. Returns provisional evidence findings, verification depth, gaps and next evidence needs. Final novelty, patentability and publication judgments remain human-gated.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "axenomia_solve_study" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
